versions.changelog: Todo@3.0.1: Better judgment, less pressure. Added Python 3 runtime clarity, smarter next-action filtering for time/energy mismatch, and real delay/archive/let-go controls in weekly review.

Todo@3.0.0: Offload the weight. Keep the momentum. Rebuilt todo into a local-first execution engine with human-friendly next actions, hot/cold momentum, mental weight tracking, daily sync, and guilt-free archive flow.
Major update: Added task capture with context, priority-based organization, energy-aware surfacing, commitment tracking, and comprehensive task management workflows
